question: India’s latitudinal extent is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**8º4' North to 37º6' North latitudes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's latitudinal extent ranges from **8º4' North to 37º6' North latitudes**.
 
• This range covers approximately **29 degrees of latitude**.
 
• The latitudinal extent influences India's **climate** and **day length** variations.
 
• It plays a significant role in the **diversity of flora and fauna** across the country.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer (23º30' N) passes through the middle of India, impacting its climatic zones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Latitudinal Extent:**

 
 
• Latitudinal extent refers to the angular distance north or south of the Equator, measured in degrees.
 
• It influences a region's climate, daylight hours, and temperature variations.
 
 
 
• **Tropic of Cancer:**
 
 
• The Tropic of Cancer is located at 23º30' North latitude.
 
• It marks the northernmost point where the sun can be directly overhead.
 
• This line passes through eight Indian states, influencing their climatic patterns.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Climate:**
 
 
• The latitudinal extent affects India's climate, contributing to its diverse climatic zones ranging from tropical in the south to temperate in the north.
 
• Seasonal variations in temperature and precipitation patterns are also influenced by latitude.
 
 
 
• **Day Length Variations:**
 
 
• Day length varies significantly from north to south due to the latitudinal extent.
 
• Regions closer to the Equator experience less variation in day length throughout the year compared to those further north.
